_comment: Names check-faa-additions.py extracts that are NOT medications we should carry. Each needs a reason. An entry here is a decision, not a mute button.

terms.adequately treated: PCOS worksheet wording, not a medication.
terms.alpha agonist: Eye-drop CLASS named in the glaucoma CACI, not a specific drug.
terms.cancerous polyp: Colon cancer table wording, not a medication.
terms.central hypothyroidism: Condition named in the hypothyroidism table, not a medication.
terms.chronic worksheet: Heading text ('Hepatitis C - Chronic Worksheet'), not a medication.
terms.cycloplegics: Eye-drop CLASS named in the glaucoma CACI, not a specific drug.
terms.diastolic: Blood pressure wording in the hypertension CACI, not a medication.
terms.glaucoma worksheet: Heading text ('CACI - Glaucoma Worksheet'), not a medication.
terms.headache worksheet: Heading text on the headache page, not a medication.
terms.hour rituximab: Extraction fragment of '72-hour rituximab (Rituxan)' on the arthritis CACI; rituximab has its own entry.
terms.hypertensive: DNI table heading ('HYPERTENSIVE (CENTRALLY ACTING)'), not a medication.
terms.incapacitating: Headache CACI wording, not a medication.
terms.metoprolol succinate: Salt form on the migraine prevention table; our metoprolol entry is what a pilot's search finds.
terms.nash: Condition (MASH/NASH) named by the liver CACI, not a medication.
terms.propranolol hydrochloride: Salt form on the migraine prevention table; our propranolol entry is what a pilot's search finds.
terms.prostaglandin analogs: Class name from the glaucoma CACI ('prostaglandin analogs (...)'), not a drug name. Read as two words once capitalised names were read (2026-10-06).
terms.substances: DNI table heading ('CONTROLLED SUBSTANCES (SCHEDULES I - V)'), not a medication.
terms.thrombocytopenia: Condition named by the thrombocytopenia table, not a medication.
terms.with aura: Migraine type in the headache CACI, not a medication.
